action.query:
SELECT c.AGE_SEGMENT, COUNT(*) AS DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT, SUM(f.SALES_AMOUNT) AS GMV, AVG(f.SALES_AMOUNT) AS AOV
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER f
JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_CUSTOMER c ON f.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
WHERE f.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND f.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
  AND f.IS_DELIVERED = TRUE
  AND f.CURRENCY = 'INR'
GROUP BY c.AGE_SEGMENT
ORDER BY DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT DESC
LIMIT 3;

Only two age segments had Delivered orders in INR during 2025. The population is all Delivered orders in INR for 2025, grouped by the DIM_CUSTOMER age segment labels. Units: order count (integer), GMV (INR), AOV (INR, six decimals). Interpretation: Gen Z and Millennials were the only age segments with Delivered orders in INR, with Gen Z leading in both order count and GMV. Average order values (AOV) were very similar between the two groups.
